GuidedDemo.title: Try the household coordinator
GuidedDemo.intro: Two independent scenarios use synthetic families and the real booking process. Try the routine visit first, then the request that needs a host.
GuidedDemo.sharedReset: Starting either scenario resets this shared demo household and clears its demo visits, requests and activity for everyone using it.
GuidedDemo.vegaBody: Two adults and two children fit the two open rooms together. Keep both rooms selected and submit to see the booking outcome.
GuidedDemo.oteroTitle: 2. Otero: a request for the hosts
GuidedDemo.oteroBody: Start afresh with two adults, a dog and a captured ground-floor access request. Select the Garage Room, submit, then review the request as a host. A floor label does not establish accessibility.
GuidedDemo.resetFailed: The demo could not be reset. It may be busy or your host session may have expired. Try again, or enter again from the sign-in page.
GuidedDemo.entryFailed: The demo was reset, but the guest could not be opened. Try starting again from here.
GuidedDemo.followBody: After a visit is confirmed, advance to its next reminder below. Return as that guest to reconfirm, or leave it unanswered and advance to the next host follow-up. If no current visit needs that step, the clock stays where it is.
GuidedDemo.returnGuest: Return to the current demo guest
GuidedDemo.synthetic: Shared synthetic demo · no guest emails are sent

DemoGuestGuide.title: Your part in this synthetic demo
DemoGuestGuide.vega: Vega: two adults and two children. Search the suggested dates, keep both open rooms selected, and submit. Their combined standard capacity fits all four guests.
DemoGuestGuide.otero: Otero: two adults and a dog, with an explicit access request already captured. Search the suggested dates, choose the ground-floor Garage Room, and submit. The hosts must review the request before confirmation.
DemoGuestGuide.generic: Search for dates, choose the exact rooms you want and submit. The resulting visit or request shows what happens next.
DemoGuestGuide.access: Ground floor does not guarantee step-free or wheelchair access. This scenario asks the hosts to review the need; it does not establish that the room is accessible.
DemoGuestGuide.pending: If the request is waiting for approval, return to the host view and review the pending decision. Then reopen this guest to see the actual result.
DemoGuestGuide.follow: After confirmation, return as host and advance to the next reminder. Return here to answer before escalation, or leave it unanswered to try escalation. Once escalated, a host follows up with the guest.
DemoGuestGuide.shared: This is shared synthetic data. Another person may reset the demo while you are using it. No guest email is sent.
